title: Agile Testing for Beginners: How Testing Fits a Sprint
description:
See how testing fits into Agile development, from story refinement to a sprint example. Learn the core principles with fictional software-testing scenarios.

Try answering: Which risk would you test first in a new checkout feature?

Next lesson: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aVPTY_zbmlU
Continue the course: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLXqX5lBoONpI

Agile Testing Masterclass — Episode 1 of 12 | English | 10-minute lesson.

In this lesson:
• Hook and introduction
• What is Agile Testing?
• Agile versus traditional testing
• Five core principles
• Agile Testing in Scrum
• Four Agile Testing quadrants
• Real-world example
• Tools and automation
